purpose: Refined acceptance specifications: the 47 unchanged supplied scenarios plus six explicitly labeled product-regression supplements.
execution_status: NOT_RUN — specifications reviewed and packaged only; no current game source/runtime inspected or executed.
binding_requirements: Equipped part IDs and geometry dimensions
Timestamped semantic input and relevant raw input

test_dimensions.coverage_policy: Core deterministic cases first; documented pairwise coverage next. Do not claim a full Cartesian product unless executed.

release_timing_sweep.status: PROPOSED — calibrate to the installed fixed tick and input semantics.
release_timing_sweep.oracle: Feasible inputs succeed without state artifacts; impossible inputs fail for an actual, logged reason.

provisional_tolerances.status: PROPOSED — review after verifying units and solver scale; never silently loosen to hide failure.
provisional_tolerances.penetration_alert_rule: max(0.002 metres, 0.03 * equipped wheel radius); per-proxy review required
provisional_tolerances.assistance_limits: Begin with no translational assistance; publish justified angular and linear budgets before enabling.

required_negative_controls: Plain air does not count as flip
Double flip not stopped at one
Cosmetic change does not change handling

scenarios.scenario: Direct RS Bri from the reported big-box lip: preload, scoop, full return, and catch.
scenarios.expected_outcome: A feasible direct Bri preserves charge and uses one takeoff; the complete scooter motion returns continuously. An accepted low-airtime attempt may fail on actual contact, never snap under the feet or fail solely because its input was requested.
scenarios.origin: Integration supplement: retained owner requirement and prior repair prompt, not a new research finding.
milestone_bindings: M3: verify full equipment motion and catch
assertions_to_implement: Record the measured RS preload at gesture acceptance and at the single launch transaction; an RS scoop must not erase the accepted charge.
Pro-profile direct takeoff requires no separate manual hop; preserve the established Arcade mapping rather than forcing one universal button.
Check accepted motion samples, part clearance, and catch-state transition independently of the requested Bri label.
No early grounded/idle/foot-IK writer resets the scooter into its riding pose while the actual Bri is incomplete.
An uncharged attempt with sufficient ramp-derived airtime may succeed; genuine insufficient-clearance/unfinished impacts remain physical.
fixture_variants_to_bind: Same approach: no charge, partial charge, full useful charge; measure actual airtime.
Feasible lip release plus source release-time sweep with fixed recorded inputs.
A genuinely too-low accepted attempt and a genuinely blocked launch; distinguish the reason for each.
scenarios.independent_oracle_requirement: Freeze initial state, real obstacle geometry, contact proxies and expected motion/catch milestones before tuning. Use recorded transforms/contact events, not a Bri request or timer alone, to establish completion.
scenarios.notes: Additional scenario specification only. No current game source/runtime was executed to create this refinement.

scenarios.scenario: Direct RS Inward from the reported big-box lip: preload, scoop, full return, and catch.
scenarios.expected_outcome: A feasible direct Inward uses the same launch authority without a separate hop or half-animation reset, while retaining the corrected distinction from Bri.
scenarios.origin: Integration supplement: retained owner requirement and prior repair prompt, not a new research finding.
milestone_bindings: M3: verify full equipment motion and catch
assertions_to_implement: Latch accepted preload through the RS scoop and record one takeoff/air-session ID.
Do not relabel Bri as Inward or reverse previously corrected animation direction as an incidental fix.
Check the actual equipment sweep, rider reach, part clearance, and return-to-catch continuously.
Early contact does not manufacture a completed catch; it is resolved physically and classified with a specific reason.
Render-rate changes do not restart the gesture, add charge twice, or skip the return phase.
fixture_variants_to_bind: No/partial/full useful charge from an identical approach.
A valid upper-transition launch and a deliberately insufficient-clearance control.
Both supported stances with the installed control profiles, using a declared pairwise coverage plan.
scenarios.independent_oracle_requirement: Measure motion and catch geometry from production state. Compare to the established Inward path without treating a matching HUD label as proof.
scenarios.notes: Additional scenario specification only. No current game source/runtime was executed to create this refinement.

scenarios.scenario: Begin Inward, then initiate a Frontflip during its airborne main sweep.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Body rotation starts promptly from the established airborne state while the same Inward timeline continues; no second linear launch or forced equipment reset occurs.
scenarios.origin: Integration supplement: explicit earlier owner combo/control requirement, not a biomechanical claim of passive midair propulsion.
milestone_bindings: M4: compare assistance off, normal and player override
assertions_to_implement: Hold LT+RT and apply deliberate forward LS only after the Inward is already active; preserve the exact timestamped semantic input.
The equipment attempt ID and progress are not restarted when the body maneuver becomes active.
The body command changes only its approved bounded angular authority; it adds no linear jump/lift impulse.
Record coupled orientation history and pose/IK outputs without double application of root rotation.
A feasible combined catch/landing succeeds; a deliberately too-late request cannot gain invisible airtime or an instant completed flip.
fixture_variants_to_bind: One supported diagonal spin direction followed by the mirrored case in the declared coverage plan.
scenarios.independent_oracle_requirement: Compare takeoff IDs, impulse sources, observed root rotation and continuing equipment transforms before/after the body command. Validate final contacts independently of the requested combo name.
scenarios.notes: Additional scenario specification only. No current game source/runtime was executed to create this refinement.

scenarios.scenario: Begin Bri, then initiate a Backflip during its airborne main sweep.
scenarios.expected_outcome: The established Bri and new backward body motion compose continuously, with controllable continuation and no default stop at one revolution.
scenarios.origin: Integration supplement: explicit earlier owner combo/control requirement, not an independently verified athlete-timing result.
assertions_to_implement: LT+RT plus backward/diagonal LS is accepted during the active airborne Bri without a new bunny-hop gate.
No phase reset, direction inversion, false Euler yaw jump, or teleport-to-feet catch occurs.
Strong continued input retains a reachable double-flip choice when the fixture supplies sufficient airtime.
Relaxed/opposite input produces bounded continuation/braking rather than runaway acceleration or an upright snap.
No extra linear energy is added on midair body-maneuver initiation.
fixture_variants_to_bind: Mid-sweep backward flip with adequate air.
Continued rotation and deliberate insufficient-airtime cases.
Both spin signs with matched feasible launch context.
scenarios.independent_oracle_requirement: Use observed root/part transforms, angular history, assist logs and collision/catch evidence; do not infer multi-turn completion from identical start/end quaternions.
scenarios.notes: Additional scenario specification only. No current game source/runtime was executed to create this refinement.

scenarios.scenario: Complete a hop/equipment trick into Manual or Nose Manual using the held gentle RS position.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Current manual intent survives touchdown; a compatible single-wheel catch starts the existing manual without requiring both wheels first, without skipping an incomplete trick, and without double banking the combo.
scenarios.origin: Integration supplement: retained owner manual/input requirement; the research supplies contact principles but does not prescribe a manual sweet spot.
assertions_to_implement: Gentle held RS down/up survives the airborne-to-supported transition without a fresh input edge.
Deep preload and eligible contextual flicks remain distinct from sustained manual input; no hidden remapping.
Finite valid rear/front wheel support and an actually completed/catchable equipment pose determine eligibility.
Landing assistance does not overwrite a valid intended single-wheel pose with an unconditional two-wheel upright snap.
An unfinished Bri/Inward cannot be rescued solely by manual intent, and score/result ownership follows the existing combo policy once.
fixture_variants_to_bind: Bunny hop into Manual and Nose Manual.
Completed Tailwhip or other already-working equipment trick into Manual.
scenarios.independent_oracle_requirement: Observe wheel contacts, deck pose, held input and catch state separately from the manual label. Check exactly-once result handling under the established combo-banking rule.
scenarios.notes: Additional scenario specification only. No current game source/runtime was executed to create this refinement.

scenarios.scenario: Lean during the small-box grind, then RS pop/trick exit and optional capture on another valid rail.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Small legal balance changes remain outside solid wood; a deliberate RS exit releases the support once, preserves useful along-edge velocity, and avoids same-rail recapture without blocking a different legitimate rail.
scenarios.origin: Integration supplement: retained owner grind-control/exit requirement plus the research contact-clearance contract.
assertions_to_implement: Recompute/check the real equipped anchor and full-assembly clearance through lateral and fore/aft lean.
Limit or reject infeasible pose changes without increasing penetration or hiding wheels.
RS pop or accepted trick gesture releases the grind once through the shared takeoff authority.
Use a bounded same-feature separation/rearm rule rather than disabling all environmental collision.
A separate reachable rail remains eligible when its own sweep/anchor/contact tests pass; a clear miss is not captured.
fixture_variants_to_bind: Both feasible grind directions on the reported production ledge.
Small lean and deliberately excessive lean.
Pop out, trick out, and another-rail capture only where a real fixture supplies valid geometry.
scenarios.independent_oracle_requirement: Record actual anchor error, minimum signed clearance, active constraint owner, takeoff count and subsequent contact feature. Repeated successful score ticks inside wood are a failure.
scenarios.notes: Additional scenario specification only. No current game source/runtime was executed to create this refinement.
